_about: Hugh Lofting's (1886-1947) books first published before 1929, as the relay asked: the Doctor Dolittle books of 1920-1928, The Story of Mrs Tubbs and Porridge Poetry. Clean Gutenberg text, plus Doctor Dolittle's Caravan as raw Internet Archive OCR of its first printing (1926). US public domain; Lofting died in 1947, so life+70 and life+80 countries differ. These are the original texts, including passages Lofting's publishers revised in 1988 for their racist caricature.

lofting-story-of-doctor-dolittle: The Story of Doctor Dolittle (1920), with Hugh Walpole's introduction

lofting-doctor-dolittles-caravan: Doctor Dolittle's Caravan (New York: Frederick A. Stokes, October 1926, first printing)

_excluded.lofting-duplicates: The Story of Doctor Dolittle (PG 26201), another transcription
_excluded.lofting-later-printings-only: PENDING: Doctor Dolittle's Circus (1924), Doctor Dolittle's Zoo (1925) and Doctor Dolittle's Garden (1927). The Internet Archive scans found are later printings (1950s-1960s, with renewal notices and new front matter about Lofting that is not itself public domain); a first-printing scan should be found before they enter the shelf
_excluded.lofting-1929-and-later: outside the relay's pre-1929 line: Noisy Nora (1929), The Twilight of Magic (1930), Gub Gub's Book (1932) and the later Dolittle books
